basic_info.description: New Price! Bright, spacious, tranquil well laid out condo with views of the Golden Gate Bridge, Alcatraz/Marin and Treasure Island. Detached on 3 sides so there is great light all day long. Two decks: one off of the dining room and another off the second bedroom. Deeded 2 car parking and a large storage room. Great location to nearby Polk Street, North Beach and the Waterfront.
